consistency.note: Trapezoidal sampled current vs charge counter on the same contiguous unplugged discharging intervals (gaps <=120s). A factor >10 mismatch after >=60s and >=1mAh counter drop is a diagnostic heuristic, not calibration. Do not multiply current by 1000 automatically. Counter/firmware errors, sampling and unit violations require device verification; power remains a device estimate.

counterDischarge.note: Device battery counter estimate, not calibrated or app-attributed. Only eligible adjacent intervals; unchanged intervals contribute elapsed time but do not assert zero power. Power uses charge-weighted endpoint voltages; short intervals reflect counter quantization.

battery.note: Device battery, signed current/power; estimates are not app consumption. byChargingStatus and fullSessionStatusSummaries preserve recorded numbers even if legacy logs reported unreliable power; top-level current/power are suppressed on detected mismatch. API arithmetic is not independent device validation. Means use recorded samples grouped by status. Battery temperature is not CPU/GPU temperature. 0% level delta does not mean zero power. Polls can miss transitions; headroom may be cached. See fullSessionSummary for authoritative counts/endpoints if sample lines were dropped.

note: Statistics use recorded successful FRAME samples. If frameLogComplete=false, FPS/P95/averages are incomplete. Error lines count only recorded errors; fallback counters have detector lifetime scope.

longRun.note: Correlations use equal-weight interval means of device cpufreq snapshots, not app core frequencies or causal evidence. Includes the final partial interval; time/thermal/ML Kit can confound correlations. mlKitInFlight is a dispatch-time hint, not verified overlap or CPU attribution. No missing policy current is filled with its maximum.
